summary: Large stadium car park beside the rail line, no homes within 90 m.
reasons: Big car park, many cars parked
Backs onto rail, industry and parkland

drivers.seclusion: Car park backs onto parkland, a rail corridor and warehouses; the only mapped dwelling is 97 m away and the rest are stadium and commercial buildings.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road off the roundabout leads straight in; marked bays with plenty of room for a van. Mapped lift gates nearby may close it out of hours.
drivers.traffic: Rail line and event crowds nearby, but the van stands in a bay off the lane.
drivers.convention: Dozens of cars parked in the imagery; mapped as staff permit and paid customer parking.

flags: Mapped as permit or fee parking; overnight rules unknown
Lift gates mapped 66 to 81 m away, not closed in imagery, with a way round
Noise from the rail line and stadium events
Low-lying: 2.5 to 3.1 m, Brisbane River 306 m away
sun_shade: Open car park, full sun; trees along the park edge shade the east side in the morning.
cannot_judge: Overnight parking rules and closing times

best_section.where: Edge of the car park just north-east of the roundabout, by the park
